svg.title: Two approaches to playback feedback
svg.desc: Both approaches retain the same map, media shortcuts, controls and response states. The proposal changes how an action and result are explained.

g.text: Two approaches to playback feedback
A
Existing-pattern comparison
Map context + media widget + recent-app access.
On-screen and steering control routes remain.
Ordinary pending, failure and unknown feedback.
Documentation-informed model; not a car replica.
B
Explicit action receipt
Same map, controls, task and service behaviour.
Separate local input from playback confirmation.
Keep the last known track visibly qualified.
No extra confirmation step to skip a track.
TEST
What could make the proposal lose?
More status text creates extra reading or confusion.
Existing shortcuts already solve the whole task.
The service cannot supply truthful playback state.
Compare with real drivers before choosing.
No vehicle integration, gaze test or measured improvement.
NOV 2026 · PROPOSED DESIGN / NO PARTICIPANT RESULTS
